description: Karnataka will introduce AI education in 1,642 government high schools from 2026–27 and appoint AI guest teachers with a monthly honorarium of ₹20,000. KARNATAKA TOP NEWS
body_lead: From the 2026-27 academic year, Artificial Intelligence (AI) will be introduced as a subject in 1,642 government high schools across Karnataka under the National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF). The government has also approved the appointment of AI guest teachers. In a major step towards bringing modern technology into classrooms, the Karnataka government has decided to introduce Artificial Intelligence (AI) as a subject in government high schools from the 2026-27 academic year.
